title: Social Connection Settings
description: Manage OAuth credentials for Google, Kakao, and Naver social sign-up/login.
read_only_message: You only have view permission. Contact an administrator if changes are required.
sub_tenant_credentials_message: Client ID/Secret are managed on the master host (mek360.com). On this site you can only save SNS on/off toggles.
master_inherit_badge: Using master keys — values below are read-only and update automatically when changed on mek360.com.
save_error: Failed to save social connection settings.
callback_url_hint: Paste this value into the Callback URL or Redirect URI field in the provider console. The module uses this URL automatically when no override is saved.
optional_secret: Enter if Client Secret is required

fields.use_master_defaults: Use master keys (default). Disable to save tenant-specific keys.
fields.google_request_auth_time: Request the Google Security Bundle auth_time claim. Enable only when the feature is enabled in Google Auth Platform.
fields.kakao_use_client_secret: Enable this and enter the secret when Kakao Client Secret is ON. The default Kakao setting is ON.

providers.kakao_description: Enter Kakao REST API key and security settings.

links.google_credentials: Issue/manage Client ID/Secret in Google Cloud Console
links.kakao_credentials: Check REST API key/Client Secret in Kakao Developers
